event_time_contract.repair_rule: When source HYDRO_END precedes PEAK_TIME but the peak remains inside the existing SAMPLE window, minimally extend HYDRO_END to PEAK_TIME; otherwise fail the hard time contract.

target_sample.exclusion_rule: Before hydrologic event merging, exclude an event only when every candidate issue window is rejected and the event therefore has no valid target sample under the unchanged minimum target coverage. Then rebuild provisional split, dynamic data, target mapping, and samples.

water_level.reference_shift_rule: Provisional TRAIN event median Tukey outer fences (Q1-3*IQR, Q3+3*IQR); exclude only when the complete event target range lies outside a fence. VALIDATION/TEST are never filtered by this rule.
